# src 中新建的 C 文件自动参与构建
target("sum")
set_standard("c17")
add_includedirs("include")
add_files("src/*.c")
set_standard("c++20")
set_mode("debug")
add_cflags("-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wshadow", "-Wconversion", "-Wundef", "-Wformat=2")
add_cxxflags("-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wshadow", "-Wconversion", "-Wundef", "-Wformat=2")
add_links("m")

#include "sum.h"
int sum(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

#ifndef SUM_H
#define SUM_H
int sum(int a, int b);
#endif
